title: kev-precedent: Status 'confirmed' outruns the weakest part (A2), and 'last PHP core RCE' is not shown
description: The one-day exploitation rests on one party (Akamai). The CVE record calls CVE-2024-4577 'Argument Injection in PHP-CGI' on Windows with certain code pages, a SAPI bug rather than the PHP core; and nothing captured shows it is the most recent PHP RCE (only that it is the most recent PHP entry in KEV). Say 'the last PHP flaw in KEV'.

comments.text: Run-3: status fixed ('reported'); still open for the text: 'the last PHP core RCE' is not carried by the CVE record, which calls CVE-2024-4577 a PHP-CGI argument injection.
